title: South Korea Has More Factory Robots Than Every Rival
hook: South Korea's factory workers have more robot coworkers than anyone.
closing: Robot density, not total installations, changes how automated a factory floor feels.
question: Would a robot coworker worry you?

segments.say: South Korea has 1,220 robots per ten thousand factory workers, the highest density of any country.
The United States has 307 robots per ten thousand workers, leaving South Korea nearly four times denser.
China has 166 robots per ten thousand workers, despite installing more robots than anyone.
